passages.text: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother’s name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.
passages.sermon:
Joash became king in the seventh year of Jehu.
Joash ruled in Jerusalem.
He reigned for forty years.
His mother was Zibiah.
Zibiah came from Beersheba.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַת־ שֶׁ֤בַע לְיֵהוּא֙ מָלַ֣ךְ יְהוֹאָ֔שׁ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִבְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃

passages.text: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
Joash did what was right.
The LORD saw Joash’s actions as right.
Jehoiada was a priest.
Jehoiada instructed Joash.
Joash did what was right as long as Jehoiada instructed him.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוֹאָ֧שׁ הַיָּשָׁ֛ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ יָמָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרָ֔הוּ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַכֹּהֵֽן׃

passages.text: Nevertheless, the high places were not removed; the people continued sacrificing and burning incense there.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel did not remove the high places.
They kept the high places.
The people continued to offer sacrifices at the high places.
They also continued to burn incense there.
passages.original: רַ֥ק הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹא־ סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money brought as sacred gifts into the house of the LORD—the census money, the money from vows, and the money brought voluntarily into the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
Joash spoke to the priests.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Collect all the money brought as sacred gifts into the house of the LORD.
This includes the census money.
This includes the money from vows.
This includes all the money anyone brings voluntarily into the house of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים כֹּל֩ כֶּ֨סֶף הַקֳּדָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ יוּבָ֤א בֵית־ יְהוָה֙ כֶּ֣סֶף עוֹבֵ֔ר אִ֕ישׁ כֶּ֥סֶף נַפְשׁ֖וֹת עֶרְכּ֑וֹ כָּל־ כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַֽעֲלֶה֙ עַ֣ל לֶב־ אִ֔ישׁ לְהָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Let every priest receive it from his constituency, and let it be used to repair any damage found in the temple.”
passages.sermon:
Joash was the king of Judah.
Joash spoke to the priests.
Joash gave the priests instructions.
Each priest must collect money from the people he serves.
The priests must use this money.
The priests must repair any damage found in the temple.
The priests must fix everything that needs repair in the house of the LORD.
passages.original: יִקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֣ת מַכָּר֑וֹ וְהֵ֗ם יְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק הַבַּ֔יִת לְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּצֵ֥א שָׁ֖ם בָּֽדֶק׃פ

passages.text: By the twenty-third year of the reign of Joash, however, the priests had not yet repaired the damage to the temple.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
He ruled for many years.
In the twenty-third year of Joash’s reign, the temple was still damaged.
The priests had not repaired the damage to the temple.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּשְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְשָׁלֹ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֑שׁ לֹֽא־ חִזְּק֥וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת־ בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: So King Joash called Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why have you not repaired the damage to the temple? Now, therefore, take no more money from your constituency, but hand it over for the repair of the temple.”
passages.sermon:
King Joash was the ruler of Judah.
Jehoiada was the chief priest.
There were other priests serving in the temple.
King Joash called Jehoiada and the other priests.
He spoke directly to them.
He asked them a question.
He said, "Why have you not repaired the damage to the temple?"
He gave them a command.
He said, "Do not take any more money from your people."
He told them what to do with the money.
He said, "Give the money for the repair of the temple."
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָא֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ לִיהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַכֹּהֵן֙ וְלַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם מַדּ֛וּעַ אֵינְכֶ֥ם מְחַזְּקִ֖ים אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק הַבָּ֑יִת וְעַתָּ֗ה אַל־ תִּקְחוּ־ כֶ֙סֶף֙ מֵאֵ֣ת מַכָּֽרֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ לְבֶ֥דֶק הַבַּ֖יִת תִּתְּנֻֽהוּ׃

passages.text: So the priests agreed that they would not receive money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.
passages.sermon: The priests made a decision.\r\nThey agreed not to take money from the people.\r\nThey also agreed not to repair the temple themselves.
passages.original: וַיֵּאֹ֖תוּ הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים לְבִלְתִּ֤י קְחַת־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הָעָ֔ם וּלְבִלְתִּ֥י חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ בֶּ֥דֶק הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: Then Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar on the right side as one enters the house of the LORD. There the priests who guarded the threshold put all the money brought into the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Jehoiada was the high priest in Jerusalem.
Jehoiada took a chest.
He made a hole in the lid of the chest.
He placed the chest beside the altar.
He put the chest on the right side as people entered the house of the LORD.
The priests guarded the entrance to the temple.
These priests put all the money brought into the house of the LORD into the chest.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד וַיִּקֹּ֥ב חֹ֖ר בְּדַלְתּ֑וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹתוֹ֩ אֵ֨צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ בַּיָּמִין בְּבֽוֹא־ אִישׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְנָֽתְנוּ־ שָׁ֤מָּה הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּ֔ף אֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַמּוּבָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Whenever they saw that there was a large amount of money in the chest, the royal scribe and the high priest would go up, count the money brought into the house of the LORD, and tie it up in bags.
passages.sermon:
The royal scribe served the king.
The high priest led the priests.
People brought money into the house of the LORD.
They put the money in a chest.
Sometimes, the chest held a large amount of money.
When the royal scribe and the high priest saw much money in the chest, they acted.
They went up to the chest.
They counted the money found in the house of the LORD.
They tied up the money in bags.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ רַ֥ב הַכֶּ֖סֶף בָּֽאָר֑וֹן וַיַּ֨עַל סֹפֵ֤ר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וְהַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וַיָּצֻ֙רוּ֙ וַיִּמְנ֔וּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַנִּמְצָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then they would put the counted money into the hands of those who supervised the work on the house of the LORD, who in turn would pay those doing the work—the carpenters, builders, masons, and stonecutters. They also purchased timber and dressed stone to repair the damage to the house of the LORD, and they paid the other expenses of the temple repairs.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of the house of the LORD supervised the repairs.
They received the counted money.
They gave the money to the workers.
The workers included carpenters and builders.
The workers also included masons and stonecutters.
They used the money to buy wood.
They used the money to buy cut stones.
They used these materials to repair the damage in the house of the LORD.
They paid for all other expenses needed to strengthen the temple.
passages.original: וְנָתְנוּ֙ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֣סֶף הַֽמְתֻכָּ֔ן עַל־ יַד עֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִים בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַיּוֹצִיאֻ֜הוּ לְחָרָשֵׁ֤י הָעֵץ֙ וְלַבֹּנִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ וְלַגֹּֽדְרִים֙ וּלְחֹצְבֵ֣י הָאֶ֔בֶן וְלִקְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְאַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְחַזֵּ֖ק אֶת־ בֶּ֣דֶק בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵ֥א עַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת לְחָזְקָֽה׃

passages.text: However, the money brought into the house of the LORD was not used for making silver basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or any articles of gold or silver for the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The house of the LORD received money.
They did not use this money to make silver basins.
They did not use it to make wick trimmers.
They did not use it to make sprinkling bowls.
They did not use it to make trumpets.
They did not use it to make any articles of gold for the house of the LORD.
They did not use it to make any articles of silver for the house of the LORD.
passages.original: אַךְ֩ לֹ֨א יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה סִפּ֥וֹת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מְזַמְּר֤וֹת מִזְרָקוֹת֙ חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת כָּל־ כְּלִ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּכְלִי־ כָ֑סֶף מִן־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף הַמּוּבָ֥א בֵית־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Instead, it was paid to those doing the work, and with it they repaired the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The leaders gave the money to the workers.
The workers repaired the house of the LORD with the money.
The money was used only for the repairs.
The workers strengthened and restored the house of the LORD.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לְעֹשֵׂ֥י הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה יִתְּנֻ֑הוּ וְחִזְּקוּ־ ב֖וֹ אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: No accounting was required from the men who received the money to pay the workmen, because they acted with integrity.
passages.sermon:
The leaders gave money to certain men.
These men received the money.
Their job was to pay the workers.
No one required these men to give an account for the money.
People trusted these men.
These men acted with honesty and integrity.
passages.original: וְלֹ֧א יְחַשְּׁב֣וּ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת־ הַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ עַל־ יָדָ֔ם לָתֵ֖ת לְעֹשֵׂ֣י הַמְּלָאכָ֑ה כִּ֥י בֶאֱמֻנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests.
passages.sermon:
The money from the guilt offerings did not go into the house of the LORD.
The money from the sin offerings did not go into the house of the LORD.
The priests kept this money.
This money belonged to the priests.
passages.original: כֶּ֤סֶף אָשָׁם֙ וְכֶ֣סֶף חַטָּא֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִהְיֽוּ׃פ

passages.text: At that time Hazael king of Aram marched up and fought against Gath and captured it. Then he decided to attack Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
Hazael was the king of Aram.
At that time, Hazael marched up to Gath.
He fought against Gath.
He captured Gath.
After this, Hazael decided to attack Jerusalem.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֗ה חֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיִּלָּ֥חֶם עַל־ גַּ֖ת וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֤שֶׂם חֲזָאֵל֙ פָּנָ֔יו לַעֲל֖וֹת עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: So King Joash of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his fathers—Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah—along with his own consecrated items and all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD and the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram. So Hazael withdrew from Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
King Joash ruled Judah.
Joash took all the sacred objects.
Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah were kings of Judah before him.
They were Joash’s fathers.
They had dedicated these sacred objects.
Joash also took his own consecrated items.
He gathered all the gold found in the treasuries of the house of the LORD.
He took all the gold in the royal palace treasuries.
Joash sent these things to Hazael.
Hazael was king of Aram.
After this, Hazael withdrew from Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֡ים אֲשֶׁר־ הִקְדִּ֣ישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וִיהוֹרָם֩ וַאֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ אֲבֹתָ֜יו מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְאֶת־ קֳדָשָׁ֔יו וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַזָּהָ֗ב הַנִּמְצָ֛א בְּאֹצְר֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וּבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח לַֽחֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיַּ֖עַל מֵעַ֥ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: As for the rest of the acts of Joash, along with all his accomplishments, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
Joash did many things during his reign.
Other acts of Joash are not listed here.
Writers recorded all his deeds in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah.
passages.original: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹאָ֖שׁ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלוֹא־ הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And the servants of Joash rose up and formed a conspiracy and killed him at Beth-millo, on the road down to Silla.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
His servants rose up against him.
They formed a conspiracy.
They killed Joash.
They killed him at Beth-millo.
Beth-millo is on the road that goes down to Silla.
passages.original: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו וַיִּקְשְׁרֽוּ־ קָ֑שֶׁר וַיַּכּוּ֙ אֶת־ יוֹאָ֔שׁ בֵּ֥ית מִלֹּ֖א הַיּוֹרֵ֥ד סִלָּֽא׃

passages.text: His servants Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer struck him down, and he died. And they buried him with his fathers in the City of David, and his son Amaziah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Joash was king of Judah.
Jozabad was the son of Shimeath.
Jehozabad was the son of Shomer.
Jozabad and Jehozabad were servants of Joash.
Jozabad and Jehozabad struck Joash down.
Joash died.
They buried Joash with his fathers.
They buried him in the City of David.
Amaziah was the son of Joash.
Amaziah became king after Joash.
passages.original: וְיוֹזָבָ֣ד בֶּן־ שִׁ֠מְעָת וִיהוֹזָבָ֨ד בֶּן־ שֹׁמֵ֤ר׀ עֲבָדָיו֙ הִכֻּ֣הוּ וַיָּמֹ֔ת וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
